goal.text: Asher's stated goal is for the company to run 90-95% autonomously.

figure.intro: These measures follow approved work through acceptance and release, and show where agent time goes. They are not a company autonomy rate: the founder's time is not yet measured.

metrics.label: Outcomes approved October 13–27 that have been accepted
metrics.blurb: Approved October 13–27 and accepted by 2026-10-30 04:00 UTC, 1 of them by the manager agent, which may accept only work that can't reach real users. The rest are in progress or stopped.
metrics.method: First outcome_approved per outcome from 2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z to 2026-10-27T04:00:00.000Z (72 h before the 2026-10-30T04:00:00.000Z cutoff); accepted = a review accept for the same outcome before the cutoff (1 by the manager agent).

metrics.label: Accepted outcomes needing a release that reached their destination within 72 hours
metrics.blurb: Merged, deployed or sent within 72 hours of acceptance, by the owner's own record. Accepted October 13–27; 42 other accepts were already live and are not counted.
metrics.method: First review accept per outcome from 2026-10-13T04:00:00.000Z to 2026-10-27T04:00:00.000Z, limited to accepts that scheduled a release; released = owner_release_done at or after the accept and within 72 h. 42 further accepts needed no release step. "Released" is the owner's record, not an independent delivery check.

metrics.label: Agent working minutes on client and product projects, October 16–30
metrics.shortLabel: Agent time on clients and products
metrics.blurb: Share of owner-agent working minutes spent on client work and products, October 16–30. The rest went to the runtime and this site. Other agent roles aren't counted.
metrics.method: Owner-session minutes clipped to 2026-10-16T04:00:00.000Z – 2026-10-30T04:00:00.000Z; outward = client (engine) and product (bets) projects; internal = the runtime and the Lab site.
